title: Are any of you guys incorporating Hermes into your workflow?
author: Mental-Frosting-7752
selftext: Instead of going back n forth between ChatGPT and Codex being the middle man, how are you guys using Hermes or any other agent? Trying to find steps on how to improve my workflow

comments.author: florodude
comments.body: I don't know what Hermes is and I don't know why I'd use anything other than claude or chatGPT

replies.author: SquirrelTomahawk
replies.body:
Hermes isn’t a ChatGPT or Claude. It’s an agent AI that orchestrates the workflow between you and ChatGPT. Essentially having a virtual employee / or multiple depending on how it's set up.

ChatGPT = strategy/review  
Codex = implementation  
Hermes = state management, routing, automation, handoffs, logs, approvals, queueing, and long-run execution.

Once projects get large enough, constantly copy/pasting between tools becomes the bottleneck — not the models themselves.

Hermes just reduces operational overhead so the AI stack behaves more like a coordinated dev pipeline instead of isolated chats.
